services.name: VR Transporter
services.desc: Embark on thrilling adventures with the VR Transporter, combining cutting-edge virtual reality and motion technology for an immersive experience like no other. Dive into prehistoric seas, blast off on Apollo 11, or race through Chicago’s futuristic skyline-all in stunning 360-degree visuals synchronized with dynamic motion. Strapped into a four-person motion chair with a high-resolution VR headset, you’ll feel every twist, turn, and thrill as you explore worlds of science and discovery. Perfect for thrill-seekers, space enthusiasts, and curious minds
